integrity: Finite direct transitivity enumeration is a consistency check, not proof of the all-dimensional identity, rate, or novelty. The complete proof is a disjoint classification and a coupling; no independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The one-point ideal/filter criterion, general scalar-count complexity and interval-order theory are prior mathematics; the claimed contribution is the explicitly refined staircase profile and its three-segment distributional limit. Extension to general Ferrers/interval orders and uniqueness in unindexed literature are unproved.
title: Three-segment limit law for one-point types over staircase interval orders
